body_lead: CHENNAI: The TVK-led government’s Vetri Thamizhagam Vision pitches for a Rs 50,000-crore state investment fund to invest in emerging sectors, building a first-of-its-kind AI City, rolling out a “no-application” welfare delivery system and guaranteeing time-bound government services under a Right to Service Act, among others, over the next five years. Furthermore, the vision document proposes a “People’s Choice Budget”, a participatory initiative where citizens directly decide how 10% of district-level development funds are utilised.
